task_description: Implement the approved, gated COMMON WORKSPACE FRAME (CR-NR-115): the shell owns one common frame (8 elements) around every workspace; each workspace owns only its content area + one status-bar segment. Adds additive Message_Line + last_action_at shell state, removes RUNNING, shortens Profile to Prof:, adds the per-Kind status-segment seam, reproduces the full frame in the snapshot/capture box (full tab bar + menu bar + message line + box-drawing grid), and folds in steering amendments. TDD-first. STOP before merge for the owner's full gate + manual check.
